post.description: A new person chooses their password; they then sign in normally.

Revokes the session and always clears the cookie, even when the session already expired.

A tab that lost its CSRF token (it lives in per-tab sessionStorage) can still sign out: the
browser's same-origin Origin header is accepted instead. Cross-site requests are stopped by
the Origin check here and in main.py, and by the SameSite=Strict cookie.
Turn two-step sign-in off: password plus a current code or a recovery code.

Start setting up an authenticator app. From My account the password is asked again;
during a sign-in that the company's policy holds for setup it was just entered.

Finish setup with a code from the app. Turns two-step sign-in on, returns 10 one-time
recovery codes (shown once) and signs out every other session (they had no second step).
Replace every recovery code with 10 new ones (the old ones stop working).
Second step of sign-in for people who turned two-step sign-in on.

Change your own password. Other devices are signed out; this one stays signed in.

Refused while the sign-in's two-step code is pending. Wrong current passwords count toward
the same lockout as sign-in; reaching it signs the account out everywhere.
Set a new password from an emailed link. Signs the account out everywhere.

post.description: Snapshot each counted balance (qty + version). Nothing posts until a manager posts it.

Post variances as COUNT_ADJUSTMENT rows. If any balance moved since it was counted the

get.description:
Server-Sent Events: `stock` whenever committed inventory state changes (polls committed
state, so events are only ever emitted after commit). Clients reconnect on close.

The generator is async: it sleeps on the event loop and only borrows a worker thread for each
short poll, so open streams can't starve the thread pool every other route runs on. Each
employee may hold MAX_STREAMS_PER_EMPLOYEE streams; the stream ends if the session does.

post.description: Compensating REVERSAL rows for the whole posting (all rows sharing its source).

and `ready` (id = latest seq). Missed rows are replayed from Last-Event-ID / `after`.
